context: IX. C ONCLUSION AND OPEN PROBLEMS In this paper we established SSM for q-colorings on all trees of maximum degree Δ whenever q ≥ Δ + 3, almost resolving Conjecture I.2. Similarly, for the antiferromagnetic Potts model we proved WSM on trees when q ≥ (1 − β)(Δ + 4) + 1. It would be interesting to fully resolve Conjecture I.2 and Conjecture I.8, namely reducing the number of colors to Δ + 1 and achieving the full range β ≥ max{0, 1 − q/Δ} respectively. We also prove spectral independence and rapid mixing of Glauber dynamics on graphs of maximum degree Δ and girth g = ΩΔ (1) whenever q ≥ Δ + 3, establishing Conjecture I.4 for a general class of graphs with a nearly optimal bound. Can one prove SSM or total influence decay for such graphs too? More generally, it is still unclear the relationship between spectral independence, SSM, and total influence decay for general spin systems.
